verses.greek: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν.
verses.literal: Jesus however went to the Mount the of Olives.
verses.dgt: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
notes: John 7:53–8:11 is bracketed in SBLGNT because of its well-known textual history. DGT follows the displayed SBLGNT text.

verses.greek: Ὄρθρου δὲ πάλιν παρεγένετο εἰς τὸ ἱερόν, καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἤρχετο· καὶ καθίσας ἐδίδασκεν αὐτούς.
verses.literal: Early in the morning then again He came into the temple and all the people were coming And having sat down He was teaching them.
verses.dgt: Early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people were coming to him. He sat down and began teaching them.

verses.greek: ἄγουσιν δὲ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πρὸς αὐτὸν γυναῖκα ἐν μοιχείᾳ καταλήφθεισαν· καὶ στήσαντες αὐτὴν ἐν μέσῳ,
verses.literal: Bring now the scribes and the Pharisees to him a woman in adultery having been grasped and having set her in the midst
verses.dgt: The scribes and Pharisees brought a woman who had been caught in adultery, and after placing her in the middle,
notes: SBLGNT and TAGNT differ in wording form here; the alignment follows SBLGNT.

verses.greek: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ, πειράζοντες· Διδάσκαλε, αὕτη ἡ γυνὴ κατελήφθη ἐπʼ αὐτοφόρῳ μοιχευομένη.
verses.literal: they say to Him testing Teacher this the woman was grasped in the very act committing adultery
verses.dgt: they said to him, testing him, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the very act of committing adultery.

verses.greek: ἐν δὲ τῷ νόμῳ Μωσῆς ἡμῖν ἐνετείλατο τὰς τοιαύτας λιθοβολεῖσθαι· σὺ οὖν τί λέγεις;
verses.literal: In now the law Moses us commanded the such to be stoned You yourself therefore what say You?
verses.dgt: Now in the law Moses commanded us to stone such women. So what do you say?”

verses.greek: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγον πειράζοντες αὐτόν, ἵνα ἔχωσιν κατηγορεῖν αὐτοῦ. ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς κάτω κύψας, τῷ δακτύλῳ ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν, μὴ προσποιούμενος.
verses.literal: This now they were saying testing Him so that they may have grounds to accuse Him. the But Jesus down having stooped the with His finger he was writing on the ground. not pretending
verses.dgt: They were saying this to test him, so that they might have grounds to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down and began writing on the ground with his finger.

verses.greek: ὡς δὲ ἐπέμενον ἐρωτῶντες αὐτόν, ἀνακύψας εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Ὁ ἀναμάρτητος ὑμῶν, πρῶτον ἐπʼ αὐτὴν τὸν λίθον βαλέτω.
verses.literal: As however they were continuing asking Him having stood up He said to them The one sinless among you the first at her the stone he should cast
verses.dgt: When they continued questioning him, he straightened up and said to them, “Let the one among you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her.”

verses.greek: καὶ πάλιν κάτω κύψας ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν.
verses.literal: And again being stooped low κύψας He was writing on the ground.
verses.dgt: And again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.
notes: SBLGNT uses two words for “stooping down” where TAGNT has a compound form; the alignment follows SBLGNT.

verses.greek: οἱ δέ, ἀκούσαντες, καὶ ὑπὸ τῆς συνειδήσεως ἐλεγχόμενοι, ἐξήρχοντο εἷς καθʼ εἷς, ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων· καὶ κατελείφθη μόνος ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἐν μέσῳ οὖσα.
verses.literal: the And having heard and by the conscience being convicted they were going away one by one having begun from the elder ones and He was left alone the Jesus and the woman in the midst already standing.
verses.dgt: When they heard this, they began going away one by one, beginning with the older ones, and Jesus was left alone, with the woman standing there in the middle.
notes: SBLGNT and TAGNT differ in wording near the end of this verse; DGT follows SBLGNT.

verses.greek: ἀνακύψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ μηδένα θεασάμενος πλὴν τὴς γυναικός, εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Ποῦ εἰσιν ἐκεῖνοι οἱ κατήγοροί σου; Οὐδείς σε κατέκρινεν;
verses.literal: Having lifted up then the Jesus and no one having seen only the woman said to her where are they they the accusers of you No one you has condemned?
verses.dgt: Jesus straightened up and said to her, “Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?”

verses.greek: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν· Οὐδείς, κύριε. εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐδὲ ἐγώ σε κρίνω· πορεύου καὶ μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε.⟧
verses.literal: the And she said No one Sir. Said then the Jesus Neither I myself you from do go and no more do sin.
verses.dgt: She said, “No one, Sir.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go, and from now on sin no more.”
notes: SBLGNT has a shorter wording here than the TAGNT variant data; DGT follows SBLGNT.

verses.greek: Πάλιν οὖν αὐτοῖς ἐλάλησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων· Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου· ὁ ἀκολουθῶν ἐμοὶ οὐ μὴ περιπατήσῃ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ, ἀλλʼ ἕξει τὸ φῶς τῆς ζωῆς.
verses.literal: Again therefore to them spoke the Jesus saying I myself am the light of the world. the one following Me myself certainly not may walk in the darkness but will have the light the of life.
verses.dgt: Then Jesus spoke to them again, saying, “I am the light of the world. The one who follows me will certainly not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.”

verses.greek: εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι· Σὺ περὶ σεαυτοῦ μαρτυρεῖς· ἡ μαρτυρία σου οὐκ ἔστιν ἀληθής.
verses.literal: Said therefore to Him the Pharisees You yourself concerning Yourself are bearing witness the testimony of You not is true.
verses.dgt: So the Pharisees said to him, “You are testifying about yourself; your testimony is not valid.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Κἂν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ, ἀληθής ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία μου, ὅτι οἶδα πόθεν ἦλθον καὶ ποῦ ὑπάγω· ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐκ οἴδατε πόθεν ἔρχομαι ἢ ποῦ ὑπάγω.
verses.literal: Answered Jesus and said to them Even if I myself shall be bearing witness concerning Myself true is the testimony of Mine because I know from where I came and where I am going You yourselves however not know from where I come or where I am going.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is valid, because I know where I came from and where I am going. But you do not know where I come from or where I am going.

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς κατὰ τὴν σάρκα κρίνετε, ἐγὼ οὐ κρίνω οὐδένα.
verses.literal: You yourselves according to the flesh judge I myself not am judging no one.
verses.dgt: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.

verses.greek: καὶ ἐὰν κρίνω δὲ ἐγώ, ἡ κρίσις ἡ ἐμὴ ἀληθινή ἐστιν, ὅτι μόνος οὐκ εἰμί, ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ πέμψας με πατήρ.
verses.literal: And if shall judge however I myself the judgment the My true is because alone not I am but I myself and the having sent Me Father.
verses.dgt: And even if I do judge, my judgment is true, because I am not alone, but I and the Father who sent me.

verses.greek: καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ δὲ τῷ ὑμετέρῳ γέγραπται ὅτι δύο ἀνθρώπων ἡ μαρτυρία ἀληθής ἐστιν.
verses.literal: And in the law also the of you it has been written that of two men the testimony true is.
verses.dgt: And in your law it is also written that the testimony of two men is valid.

verses.greek: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ καὶ μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὁ πέμψας με πατήρ.
verses.literal: I myself am the One bearing witness concerning Myself and bears witness concerning Me the having sent Me Father.
verses.dgt: I am the one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

verses.greek: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ· Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ πατήρ σου; ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Οὔτε ἐμὲ οἴδατε οὔτε τὸν πατέρα μου· εἰ ἐμὲ ᾔδειτε, καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου ἂν ᾔδειτε.
verses.literal: They were saying therefore to Him Where is the Father of You? Answered Jesus Neither Me myself you know nor know the Father of Mine. If Me myself you had known also the Father of Mine then would you have known.
verses.dgt: Then they were saying to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

verses.greek: ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ἐλάλησεν ἐν τῷ γαζοφυλακίῳ διδάσκων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ· καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπίασεν αὐτόν, ὅτι οὔπω ἐληλύθει ἡ ὥρα αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: These the declarations He spoke in the treasury teaching in the temple and no one seized Him for not yet had come the hour of Him.
verses.dgt: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury while teaching in the temple, and no one seized him because his hour had not yet come.

verses.greek: Εἶπεν οὖν πάλιν αὐτοῖς· Ἐγὼ ὑπάγω καὶ ζητήσετέ με, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ὑμῶν ἀποθανεῖσθε· ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν.
verses.literal: He said then again to them I myself am going away and you will seek Me and in the sin of you you will die where I myself go you yourselves not are able to come.
verses.dgt: Then he said to them again, “I am going away, and you will seek me and will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come.”

verses.greek: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Μήτι ἀποκτενεῖ ἑαυτὸν ὅτι λέγει· Ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν;
verses.literal: Were saying therefore the Jews surely not ever will He kill Himself for He says Where I myself go you yourselves not are able to come’?
verses.dgt: So the Jews were saying, “He will not kill himself, will he, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?”

verses.greek: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Ὑμεῖς ἐκ τῶν κάτω ἐστέ, ἐγὼ ἐκ τῶν ἄνω εἰμί· ὑμεῖς ἐκ τούτου τοῦ κόσμου ἐστέ, ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου.
verses.literal: And He was saying to them You yourselves from the below are I myself from the above am You yourselves of this the world are I myself not am of the world this.
verses.dgt: And he was saying to them, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.

verses.greek: εἶπον οὖν ὑμῖν ὅτι ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν· ἐὰν γὰρ μὴ πιστεύσητε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι, ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν.
verses.literal: I said therefore to you that you will die in the sins of you only for unless you shall believe that I myself am He you will die in the sins of you.
verses.dgt: Therefore I told you that you will die in your sins, for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

verses.greek: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ· Σὺ τίς εἶ; εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Τὴν ἀρχὴν ὅ τι καὶ λαλῶ ὑμῖν;
verses.literal: They were saying therefore to Him You yourself who are? Said to them the Jesus From the beginning which one also I am saying to you.
verses.dgt: So they were saying to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “What I have been telling you from the beginning.

verses.greek: πολλὰ ἔχω περὶ ὑμῶν λαλεῖν καὶ κρίνειν· ἀλλʼ ὁ πέμψας με ἀληθής ἐστιν, κἀγὼ ἃ ἤκουσα παρʼ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα λαλῶ εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
verses.literal: Many things I have concerning you to say and to judge but the One having sent Me true is and I myself what I have heard from Him these things I say to the world.
verses.dgt: I have many things to say and to judge concerning you, but the one who sent me is true, and what I heard from him, these things I speak to the world.”

verses.greek: οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῖς ἔλεγεν.
verses.literal: Not they understood that about the Father to them He was speaking.
verses.dgt: They did not understand that he was speaking to them about the Father.

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὅταν ὑψώσητε τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, τότε γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ ποιῶ οὐδέν, ἀλλὰ καθὼς ἐδίδαξέν με ὁ πατὴρ ταῦτα λαλῶ.
verses.literal: Said therefore the Jesus When you may have lifted up the Son the of Man then you will know that I myself am He and from Myself I do no thing but even as taught Me the Father these things I speak.
verses.dgt: So Jesus said to them, “When you lift up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he and that I do nothing from myself, but I speak these things just as the Father taught me.

verses.greek: καὶ ὁ πέμψας με μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν· οὐκ ἀφῆκέν με μόνον, ὅτι ἐγὼ τὰ ἀρεστὰ αὐτῷ ποιῶ πάντοτε.
verses.literal: And the One having sent Me with Me is not He has left Me alone because I myself the things pleasing to Him do always.
verses.dgt: And the one who sent me is with me. He has not left me alone, because I always do the things pleasing to him.”

verses.greek: ταῦτα αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν.
verses.literal: These things when he is speaking many believed in Him.
verses.dgt: As he was speaking these things, many believed in him.

verses.greek: Ἔλεγεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς πεπιστευκότας αὐτῷ Ἰουδαίους· Ἐὰν ὑμεῖς μείνητε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τῷ ἐμῷ, ἀληθῶς μαθηταί μού ἐστε,
verses.literal: Was saying therefore the Jesus to the having believed in Him Jews If you yourselves shall abide in the word the of Mine truly disciples of Mine you are
verses.dgt: So Jesus was saying to the Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, you truly are my disciples,

verses.greek: καὶ γνώσεσθε τὴν ἀλήθειαν, καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια ἐλευθερώσει ὑμᾶς.
verses.literal: And you will know the truth and the truth will set free you.
verses.dgt: and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθησαν πρὸς αὐτόν· Σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐσμεν καὶ οὐδενὶ δεδουλεύκαμεν πώποτε· πῶς σὺ λέγεις ὅτι Ἐλεύθεροι γενήσεσθε;
verses.literal: They answered unto Him Seed of Abraham we are and to no one have we been under bondage ever How You yourself say that Free you will become’?
verses.dgt: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring and have never been enslaved to anyone. How can you say, ‘You will become free’?”

verses.greek: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν δοῦλός ἐστιν τῆς ἁμαρτίας·
verses.literal: Answered them the Jesus Amen Amen I say to you that everyone who is practicing the sin a slave is of the sin.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered them, “Truly, truly, I say to you: everyone who practices sin is a slave of sin.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ δοῦλος οὐ μένει ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· ὁ υἱὸς μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
verses.literal: the Now the slave not abides in the house to the age the son abides to the age.
verses.dgt: Now the slave does not remain in the household forever; the son remains forever.

verses.greek: ἐὰν οὖν ὁ υἱὸς ὑμᾶς ἐλευθερώσῃ, ὄντως ἐλεύθεροι ἔσεσθε.
verses.literal: If therefore the Son you shall set free indeed free you will be.
verses.dgt: So if the Son sets you free, you will truly be free.

verses.greek: οἶδα ὅτι σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐστε· ἀλλὰ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι, ὅτι ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐμὸς οὐ χωρεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: I know that seed of Abraham you are but you seek Me to kill because the word the of Mine not receives a place in you.
verses.dgt: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you are seeking to kill me because my word has no place in you.

verses.greek: ἃ ἐγὼ ἑώρακα παρὰ τῷ πατρὶ λαλῶ· καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν ἃ ἠκούσατε παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ποιεῖτε.
verses.literal: Those which I myself have seen with the Father I speak also you yourselves therefore what things you have heard from the father you do.
verses.dgt: I speak the things I have seen with my Father, and you therefore do the things you have heard from your father.”

verses.greek: Ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ ἐστιν. λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ τέκνα τοῦ Ἀβραάμ ἐστε, τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ ἐποιεῖτε·
verses.literal: They answered and they said to Him The father of us Abraham is. Says to them the Jesus If children the of Abraham you are the works the of Abraham you perform
verses.dgt: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you are Abraham’s children, do the works of Abraham.

verses.greek: νῦν δὲ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι, ἄνθρωπον ὃς τὴν ἀλήθειαν ὑμῖν λελάληκα ἣν ἤκουσα παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ· τοῦτο Ἀβραὰμ οὐκ ἐποίησεν.
verses.literal: now however you seek Me to kill a man who the truth to you has spoken that I heard from the God This Abraham not did.
verses.dgt: But now you are seeking to kill me, a man who has spoken to you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do this.

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν. εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ἡμεῖς ἐκ πορνείας οὐ γεγεννήμεθα· ἕνα πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν θεόν.
verses.literal: You yourselves are doing the works of the father of you. They said to Him We ourselves of sexual immorality not have been born one Father we have the God.
verses.dgt: You are doing the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born from sexual immorality. We have one Father—God.”

verses.greek: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ ὁ θεὸς πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἦν ἠγαπᾶτε ἂν ἐμέ, ἐγὼ γὰρ ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἥκω· οὐδὲ γὰρ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ ἐλήλυθα, ἀλλʼ ἐκεῖνός με ἀπέστειλεν.
verses.literal: Said to them the Jesus If the God Father of you were you were loving then would Me myself I myself for from the God came forth and am here. not for by Myself have I come but He Me sent.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love me, for I came forth from God and am here. I have not come from myself; he sent me.

verses.greek: διὰ τί τὴν λαλιὰν τὴν ἐμὴν οὐ γινώσκετε; ὅτι οὐ δύνασθε ἀκούειν τὸν λόγον τὸν ἐμόν.
verses.literal: Because of why the speech the of Mine not do you understand? Because not you are able to hear the word the of Mine.
verses.dgt: Why do you not understand what I say? Because you are not able to hear my word.

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς τοῦ διαβόλου ἐστὲ καὶ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν θέλετε ποιεῖν. ἐκεῖνος ἀνθρωποκτόνος ἦν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ οὐκ ἔστηκεν, ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν αὐτῷ. ὅταν λαλῇ τὸ ψεῦδος, ἐκ τῶν ἰδίων λαλεῖ, ὅτι ψεύστης ἐστὶν καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: You yourselves of the father the devil are and the desires of the father of you you desire to do. He a murderer was from the beginning and in the truth not it has stood because not there is truth in him. Whenever he may speak the falsehood from the his own he speaks for a liar he is and the father of it.
verses.dgt: You are from your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning and has not stood in the truth, because there is no truth in him. Whenever he speaks falsehood, he speaks from what is his own, because he is a liar and the father of it.

verses.greek: ἐγὼ δὲ ὅτι τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω, οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι.
verses.literal: I myself now because the truth speak not you do believe Me!
verses.dgt: But because I speak the truth, you do not believe me.

verses.greek: τίς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐλέγχει με περὶ ἁμαρτίας; εἰ ἀλήθειαν λέγω, διὰ τί ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι;
verses.literal: Which of you convicts me concerning sin? If the truth I speak because of why you yourselves not do believe Me?
verses.dgt: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I speak the truth, why do you not believe me?

verses.greek: ὁ ὢν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ θεοῦ ἀκούει· διὰ τοῦτο ὑμεῖς οὐκ ἀκούετε ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἐστέ.
verses.literal: He who is of the God the declarations the of God hears because of this you yourselves not hear because of the God not you are.
verses.dgt: The one who is from God hears the words of God. This is why you do not hear: because you are not from God.”

verses.greek: Ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Οὐ καλῶς λέγομεν ἡμεῖς ὅτι Σαμαρίτης εἶ σὺ καὶ δαιμόνιον ἔχεις;
verses.literal: Answered the Jews and said to Him Surely rightly say we ourselves that a Samaritan are You yourself and a demon have?
verses.dgt: The Jews answered him, “Are we not right in saying that you are a Samaritan and have a demon?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγὼ δαιμόνιον οὐκ ἔχω, ἀλλὰ τιμῶ τὸν πατέρα μου, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀτιμάζετέ με.
verses.literal: Answered Jesus I myself a demon not have but I honor the Father of Mine and you yourselves dishonor Me.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered, “I do not have a demon. Instead, I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.

verses.greek: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ ζητῶ τὴν δόξαν μου· ἔστιν ὁ ζητῶν καὶ κρίνων.
verses.literal: I myself now not seek the glory of Mine there is One seeking it and judging.
verses.dgt: I do not seek my own glory; there is one who seeks it and judges.

verses.greek: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐάν τις τὸν ἐμὸν λόγον τηρήσῃ, θάνατον οὐ μὴ θεωρήσῃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
verses.literal: Amen Amen I say to you if anyone the My word shall keep death certainly not shall he see to the age.
verses.dgt: Truly, truly, I say to you: if anyone keeps my word, he will certainly never see death.”

verses.greek: εἶπον αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Νῦν ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι δαιμόνιον ἔχεις. Ἀβραὰμ ἀπέθανεν καὶ οἱ προφῆται, καὶ σὺ λέγεις· Ἐάν τις τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσῃ, οὐ μὴ γεύσηται θανάτου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα·
verses.literal: Said to Him the Jews Now we have known that a demon You have. Abraham died and the prophets and You yourself say If anyone the word of Mine shall keep certainly not shall he taste of death to the age.
verses.dgt: The Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and so did the prophets, yet you say, ‘If anyone keeps my word, he will certainly never taste death.’

verses.greek: μὴ σὺ μείζων εἶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ, ὅστις ἀπέθανεν; καὶ οἱ προφῆται ἀπέθανον· τίνα σεαυτὸν ποιεῖς;
verses.literal: Surely not You yourself greater are than the father of us Abraham who died? And the prophets died! Whom yourself make You?
verses.dgt: You are not greater than our father Abraham, who died, are you? The prophets also died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ἐὰν ἐγὼ δοξάσω ἐμαυτόν, ἡ δόξα μου οὐδέν ἐστιν· ἔστιν ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ δοξάζων με, ὃν ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐστιν,
verses.literal: Answered Jesus If I myself shall glorify Myself the glory of Mine no thing is it is the Father of Mine who is glorifying Me of whom you yourselves say that God of us He is
verses.dgt: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, the one of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’

verses.greek: καὶ οὐκ ἐγνώκατε αὐτόν, ἐγὼ δὲ οἶδα αὐτόν· κἂν εἴπω ὅτι οὐκ οἶδα αὐτόν, ἔσομαι ὅμοιος ὑμῖν ψεύστης· ἀλλὰ οἶδα αὐτὸν καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ τηρῶ.
verses.literal: And not you have known Him I myself however know Him. And if I shall say that not I know Him I will be like you a liar But I know Him and the word of Him I keep.
verses.dgt: Yet you have not known him. But I know him. If I were to say that I do not know him, I would be a liar like you. But I know him and keep his word.

verses.greek: Ἀβραὰμ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἠγαλλιάσατο ἵνα ἴδῃ τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν ἐμήν, καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐχάρη.
verses.literal: Abraham the father of you rejoiced in that he may see the day the of Mine and he saw and rejoiced.
verses.dgt: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see my day, and he saw it and rejoiced.”

verses.greek: εἶπον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πρὸς αὐτόν· Πεντήκοντα ἔτη οὔπω ἔχεις καὶ Ἀβραὰμ ἑώρακας;
verses.literal: Said therefore the Jews to Him Fifty years old not yet are You and Abraham You have seen?
verses.dgt: So the Jews said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and you have seen Abraham?”

verses.greek: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, πρὶν Ἀβραὰμ γενέσθαι ἐγὼ εἰμί.
verses.literal: Said to them Jesus Amen Amen I say to you before Abraham being I myself am.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you: before Abraham came to be, I am.”

verses.greek: ἦραν οὖν λίθους ἵνα βάλωσιν ἐπʼ αὐτόν· Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐκρύβη καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ.
verses.literal: They took up therefore stones that they might cast at Him. Jesus however hid Himself and He went forth out of the temple
verses.dgt: So they picked up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple.
